column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each usage record.
A CHAR(10) NOT NULL foreign key referencing ArtifactsCore(ArtRegistry), indicating which artifact is being used.
A CHAR(12) foreign key referencing Showcases(ShowcaseReg) if a showcase is involved in the usage.
A BIGINT foreign key referencing SensitivityData(SensitivityRegistry). Links usage requirements to known sensitivities.
A CHAR(20) describing how often the artifact is rotated (possible values: 'Permanent', 'Resting', 'Active').
A SMALLINT indicating how many months the artifact is displayed in a single rotation.
A SMALLINT for how many months the artifact rests between rotations.
A VARCHAR(120) listing any special display requirements (possible values: 'Special', 'Standard', 'Custom').
A VARCHAR(60) describing special storage requirements (possible values: 'Standard', 'Custom', 'Special').
A VARCHAR(80) specifying guidelines for handling (possible values: 'Custom', 'Special', 'Standard').
A TEXT field detailing transport requirements (possible values: 'Custom', 'Special', 'Standard').
A VARCHAR(90) summarizing packing methods (possible values: 'Custom', 'Special', 'Standard').
A CHAR(10) indicating how often the artifact is accessed for research (possible values: 'Frequent', 'Rare', 'Occasional').
A CHAR(15) describing how often the artifact goes on public display (possible values: 'Frequent', 'Occasional', 'Rare').
A CHAR(12) specifying how frequently the artifact is loaned out (possible values: 'Occasional', 'Frequent', 'Rare').
A CHAR(10) indicating how frequently the artifact is handled (possible values: 'Rare', 'Frequent', 'Occasional').
A VARCHAR(20) describing how often documentation is updated (possible values: 'Frequent', 'Rare', 'Occasional').
A VARCHAR(35) for how often the artifact is monitored (possible values: 'Monthly', 'Daily', 'Weekly').
A CHAR(15) for the frequency of condition assessments (possible values: 'Monthly', 'Quarterly', 'Annually').
A CHAR(15) indicating the maintenance schedule (possible values: 'Monthly', 'Weekly', 'Quarterly').
A CHAR(15) describing the routine inspection frequency (possible values: 'Weekly', 'Monthly', 'Daily').
A CHAR(15) stating how often instruments are calibrated (possible values: 'Monthly', 'Quarterly', 'Annually').
A VARCHAR(40) noting any certification status (possible values: 'Expired', 'Current', 'Pending').
A VARCHAR(55) summarizing compliance (possible values: 'Non-compliant', 'Partial', 'Compliant').
A CHAR(10) indicating the result of a related audit (possible values: 'Passed', 'Pending', 'Failed').
A VARCHAR(70) describing quality control status (possible values: 'Failed', 'Passed', 'Review').
